panels.title: 失敗率（成員 × repo；failed+errored / (total - canceled)）
panels.description: 排除 is_post_merge 與 is_deploy_event。對照月報第 1 表。

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT m.display_name AS member, r.full_name AS repo, b.status, b.is_failure FROM builds b JOIN repos r ON r.id = b.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = b.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND m.display_name ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND b.started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND b.started_at < $__timeTo() AND NOT b.is_post_merge AND NOT b.is_deploy_event), agg AS (SELECT member, repo, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'CANCELED') AS denom, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_failure AND status <> 'CANCELED') AS fails FROM base GROUP BY member, repo), overall AS (SELECT member, 'Overall' AS repo, SUM(denom) AS denom, SUM(fails) AS fails FROM agg GROUP BY member) SELECT member, repo, CASE WHEN denom > 0 THEN fails || '/' || denom || ' (' || ROUND(fails::numeric * 100 / denom, 1) || '%)' ELSE '-' END AS rate FROM (SELECT member, repo, denom, fails, 0 AS ord FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT member, repo, denom, fails, 1 AS ord FROM overall) combined ORDER BY member, ord, repo

panels.title: 失敗成本（成員 × repo；GHA Linux $0.008/min）
panels.description: (failed+errored) duration 加總 × $0.008/min。canceled 不計。對照月報第 2 表。

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT m.display_name AS member, r.full_name AS repo, COALESCE(SUM(b.duration_seconds) FILTER (WHERE b.is_failure AND b.status <> 'CANCELED'), 0) / 60.0 * 0.008 AS cost FROM builds b JOIN repos r ON r.id = b.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = b.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND m.display_name ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND b.started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND b.started_at < $__timeTo() AND NOT b.is_post_merge AND NOT b.is_deploy_event GROUP BY m.display_name, r.full_name) SELECT member, repo, CASE WHEN cost > 0 THEN '$' || to_char(cost, 'FM999990.00') ELSE '-' END AS cost FROM base ORDER BY member, repo

panels.title: PR 迭代次數（成員 × repo；builds / PRs）
panels.description: 理想 = 1.0；越高代表 PR 反覆推 commit。對照月報第 3 表。

targets.rawSql: WITH pr_builds AS (SELECT m.display_name AS member, r.full_name AS repo, b.pr_number, COUNT(*) AS build_count FROM builds b JOIN repos r ON r.id = b.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = b.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND m.display_name ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND b.started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND b.started_at < $__timeTo() AND b.is_pull_request AND b.pr_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.display_name, r.full_name, b.pr_number), agg AS (SELECT member, repo, SUM(build_count)::int AS builds, COUNT(*)::int AS prs FROM pr_builds GROUP BY member, repo) SELECT member, repo, CASE WHEN prs > 0 THEN builds || '/' || prs || ' (' || to_char(builds::float / prs, 'FM990.0') || ')' ELSE '-' END AS iteration FROM agg ORDER BY member, repo

panels.title: PR size × Review latency（中位 / p90 / p100，含未 review lower bound，小時）
panels.description: 對照月報第 4 表。未 review PR 用「now（或月底）- ready_at」當 lower bound。

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT pr.size_bucket, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(pr.first_review_at, pr.merged_at, pr.closed_at, LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, NOW())) - pr.ready_at)) / 3600.0 AS lat_h, (pr.first_review_at IS NULL) AS unreviewed FROM pull_requests pr JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.repo_id JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr.pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND pr.ready_at IS NOT NULL AND pr.size_bucket IS NOT NULL), per_bucket AS (SELECT size_bucket AS bucket, to_char(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS median, to_char(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS p90, to_char(MAX(lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS p100, COUNT(*)::text AS n, NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE unreviewed)::text, '0') AS unreviewed FROM base GROUP BY size_bucket), overall AS (SELECT 'Overall' AS bucket, to_char(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS median, to_char(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS p90, to_char(MAX(lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h' AS p100, COUNT(*)::text AS n, NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE unreviewed)::text, '0') AS unreviewed FROM base), combined AS (SELECT * FROM per_bucket UNION ALL SELECT * FROM overall) SELECT bucket, median, p90, p100, n, unreviewed FROM combined ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'XS' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'L' THEN 4 WHEN 'XL' THEN 5 WHEN 'Overall' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END

panels.title: PR Lifecycle p90（Pickup / Approval / Merge，小時）

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT pr.size_bucket, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.first_review_at - pr.ready_at)) / 3600.0 AS pickup_h, pr.time_to_approval::float / 3600.0 AS approval_h, pr.time_to_merge::float / 3600.0 AS merge_h FROM pull_requests pr JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.repo_id JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr.pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND pr.ready_at IS NOT NULL AND pr.size_bucket IS NOT NULL), per_bucket AS (SELECT size_bucket AS bucket, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pickup_h) AS pickup_p90_raw, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY approval_h) AS approval_p90_raw, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY merge_h) AS merge_p90_raw, COUNT(*)::text AS n FROM base GROUP BY size_bucket), overall AS (SELECT 'Overall' AS bucket, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pickup_h) AS pickup_p90_raw, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY approval_h) AS approval_p90_raw, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY merge_h) AS merge_p90_raw, COUNT(*)::text AS n FROM base), combined AS (SELECT * FROM per_bucket UNION ALL SELECT * FROM overall) SELECT bucket, CASE WHEN pickup_p90_raw < 24 THEN to_char(pickup_p90_raw, 'FM9990.0') || 'h' ELSE to_char(pickup_p90_raw / 24.0, 'FM9990.0') || 'd' END AS pickup_p90, CASE WHEN approval_p90_raw < 24 THEN to_char(approval_p90_raw, 'FM9990.0') || 'h' ELSE to_char(approval_p90_raw / 24.0, 'FM9990.0') || 'd' END AS approval_p90, CASE WHEN merge_p90_raw < 24 THEN to_char(merge_p90_raw, 'FM9990.0') || 'h' ELSE to_char(merge_p90_raw / 24.0, 'FM9990.0') || 'd' END AS merge_p90, n FROM combined ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'XS' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'L' THEN 4 WHEN 'XL' THEN 5 WHEN 'Overall' THEN 6 ELSE 99 END

panels.title: PR review latency（成員 × size；中位 / p90 (n=N)，小時）

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT m.display_name AS member, pr.size_bucket, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(pr.first_review_at, pr.merged_at, pr.closed_at, LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, NOW())) - pr.ready_at)) / 3600.0 AS lat_h FROM pull_requests pr JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = pr.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND m.display_name ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr.pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND pr.ready_at IS NOT NULL AND pr.size_bucket IS NOT NULL) SELECT member, size_bucket, to_char(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h/' || to_char(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lat_h), 'FM9990.0') || 'h (n=' || COUNT(*) || ')' AS cell FROM base GROUP BY member, size_bucket ORDER BY member, CASE size_bucket WHEN 'XS' THEN 1 WHEN 'S' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'L' THEN 4 WHEN 'XL' THEN 5 ELSE 99 END

panels.title: PR Review latency 週趨勢（各 size bucket median，小時）
panels.description: 每週各 size bucket 的 median review latency，含未 review lower bound。

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', pr.pr_created_at) AS time, pr.size_bucket AS metric, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(pr.first_review_at, pr.merged_at, pr.closed_at, LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, NOW())) - pr.ready_at)) / 3600.0) AS value FROM pull_requests pr JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.repo_id JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr.pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND pr.ready_at IS NOT NULL AND pr.size_bucket IS NOT NULL AND (pr.first_review_at IS NOT NULL OR pr.merged_at IS NOT NULL OR pr.closed_at IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 每日 passed build 中位時間（每 repo 一條，分鐘）
panels.description: 對照月報第 6 項。passed only，不過濾成員。

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', b.started_at) AS time, r.full_name AS metric, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.duration_seconds) / 60.0 AS value FROM builds b JOIN repos r ON r.id = b.repo_id JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND b.started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND b.started_at < $__timeTo() AND b.status = 'PASSED' AND b.duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND NOT b.is_post_merge AND NOT b.is_deploy_event GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 失敗 build 清單（無 cause）
panels.description: 對照月報第 7 項。cause 分類待 schema + classifier 接入後再加。

targets.rawSql: SELECT b.started_at AS "date", m.display_name AS "member", r.full_name AS "repo", b.status AS "state", b.external_id AS "build", b.branch AS "branch", b.duration_seconds / 60.0 AS "duration_min", CASE WHEN b.status <> 'CANCELED' THEN b.duration_seconds / 60.0 * 0.008 ELSE 0 END AS "cost_usd" FROM builds b JOIN repos r ON r.id = b.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = b.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND m.display_name ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND b.started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND b.started_at < $__timeTo() AND b.is_failure AND NOT b.is_post_merge AND NOT b.is_deploy_event ORDER BY b.started_at DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: 成員互 Approve 矩陣（approved PR 數）
panels.description: 列：reviewer，欄：PR 作者。同一 PR 同一 reviewer 多次 approve 只算一次。

targets.rawSql: WITH agg AS (SELECT prr.reviewer_account, pr.author_account, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS approved_prs FROM pull_request_reviews prr JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prr.pull_request_id JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.repo_id JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id JOIN members reviewer_m ON reviewer_m.github_account = prr.reviewer_account JOIN group_members reviewer_gm ON reviewer_gm.member_id = reviewer_m.id AND reviewer_gm.group_id = gr.group_id JOIN members author_m ON author_m.github_account = pr.author_account JOIN group_members author_gm ON author_gm.member_id = author_m.id AND author_gm.group_id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr.pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND prr.state = 'approved' GROUP BY prr.reviewer_account, pr.author_account) SELECT reviewer_m.display_name AS reviewer, author_m.display_name AS author, agg.approved_prs FROM agg JOIN members reviewer_m ON reviewer_m.github_account = agg.reviewer_account JOIN members author_m ON author_m.github_account = agg.author_account ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: 善心人士排行（群組內成員 comment 數，不含 AI 帳號）
panels.description: 統計群組內成員在其他成員 PR 上的 commented review 數，由多到少排列。

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.display_name AS reviewer, COUNT(*) AS comments FROM pull_request_reviews prr JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prr.pull_request_id JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.repo_id JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = prr.reviewer_account JOIN group_members gm ON gm.member_id = m.id AND gm.group_id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr.pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND prr.state = 'commented' AND prr.reviewer_account NOT LIKE '%[bot]%' AND prr.reviewer_account <> pr.author_account GROUP BY m.display_name ORDER BY comments DESC

panels.title: 高延遲 PR 清單（review latency 由高到低）
panels.description: 含未 review PR（lower bound）。latency_h 欄位點擊可開啟 GitHub PR。

targets.rawSql: SELECT pr.pr_created_at AS created, m.display_name AS member, r.full_name AS repo, pr.number AS pr_number, pr.size_bucket AS size, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(pr.first_review_at, pr.merged_at, pr.closed_at, LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamp, NOW())) - pr.ready_at)) / 3600.0, 1) AS latency_h, (pr.closed_at IS NULL AND pr.merged_at IS NULL) AS opening, 'https://github.com/' || r.full_name || '/pull/' || pr.number AS url FROM pull_requests pr JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = pr.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND m.display_name ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND pr.pr_created_at >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.pr_created_at < $__timeTo() AND pr.ready_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY latency_h DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: 成員失敗率週趨勢（overall，%）
panels.description: 每人每週的 overall 失敗率（跨所有 repo）。排除 is_post_merge 與 is_deploy_event。

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', b.started_at) AS week, m.display_name AS metric, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status <> 'CANCELED') AS denom, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.is_failure AND b.status <> 'CANCELED') AS fails FROM builds b JOIN repos r ON r.id = b.repo_id JOIN members m ON m.github_account = b.author_account JOIN group_repos gr ON gr.repo_id = r.id JOIN group_members gm ON gm.group_id = gr.group_id AND gm.member_id = m.id JOIN groups g ON g.id = gr.group_id WHERE g.slug ~ ('^(' || '${group:pipe}' || ')$') AND m.display_name ~ ('^(' || '${member:pipe}' || ')$') AND b.started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND b.started_at < $__timeTo() AND NOT b.is_post_merge AND NOT b.is_deploy_event GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT week AS time, metric, CASE WHEN denom > 0 THEN ROUND(fails::numeric * 100 / denom, 1) ELSE NULL END AS value FROM base ORDER BY 1, 2
